speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have been suffering from a longstanding pruritic rash, along with numbness and tingling in your palms. To help me narrow down the cause, has this rash appeared on other parts of your body, or is it limited to your hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leishmaniasis (cutaneous and/or leishmanial cutaneous leishmaniasis with neuropathy).

The patient's history of a pruritic rash on the upper body and face, combined with work exposure to soil and livestock, strongly suggests a parasitic infection. I will confirm this by ordering a specific diagnostic test.

REQUEST TEST: Serology for Leishmania species.
